# Wikipedia transcriptions (UEFA Europa League knockout legs)

openfootball does not cover the UEFA Europa League for 2012/13–2019/20 or 2025/26,
so every leg score for those seasons was transcribed from the English Wikipedia
pages titled "<season> UEFA Europa League knockout phase" (accessed 21 October 2026):

| File | Page |
|---|---|
| uel_2012-13.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012%E2%80%9313_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2013-14.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2013%E2%80%9314_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2014-15.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2014%E2%80%9315_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2015-16.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015%E2%80%9316_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2016-17.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016%E2%80%9317_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2017-18.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2017%E2%80%9318_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2018-19.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018%E2%80%9319_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2019-20.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019%E2%80%9320_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |
| uel_2025-26.csv | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025%E2%80%9326_UEFA_Europa_League_knockout_phase |

Scores are final scores (including extra time). Each file is used only as an
independent check against data/raw/UEFA_Tie_Data_RAW.xlsx (see src/verify_raw.py).
Match results are facts; the page text is © Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0.
